title: Functional phenotyping of circulating human cytotoxic T cells and NK cells using a 16-color flow cytometry panel
protocol: Place BD Pharmingen™ Stain Buffer (FBS) and BD Horizon™ Brilliant Stain Buffer (BSB) Plus on ice.
Bring antibodies and FVS575V to room temperature, protected from light.
Quickly spin the antibody vials and pipette volumes from the top of the tube.
Calculate the number of polystyrene tubes required.
Label tubes with specificity names and abbreviations for single-stain controls (SC), fluorescence minus one (FMO), and full panel (FP).
Determine volume of each antibody based on optimal concentrations.
Pipette BSB Plus into a polystyrene tube.
Add antibodies to cell surface markers according to Table 3.
Create FMO controls by adding BSB Plus and all surface antibodies except one, for five different missing antibodies: CD159a-BV480, CD314-BV711, HLA-DR-BV786, CD95-PE-Cy5, CD127 PE-Cy5.5.
Add BSB Plus (10 μL per sample) to 14 labeled polystyrene tubes for each surface marker and one for unstained cells.
Add each antibody to its respective tube.
Gently vortex the tubes continuously at 300 rpm and press against the vortex for 5 seconds, carefully avoiding spills.
Place tubes on ice, protected from light.
Distribute equal volumes of the full panel cocktail into new polystyrene tubes, one tube per sample.
Dispense 100 μL of blood into the single control tubes for cell surface markers and FMO tubes.
Dispense 200 μL of blood into the full panel tubes.
Add 1 μL of FVS575V into the FMO tubes and the FVS575V/BV605 single control tube.
Add 2 μL of FVS575V into the full panel tubes.
Briefly vortex the tubes.
Incubate the tubes at room temperature for 25 minutes, protected from light.

While the cells are staining for cell surface markers, prepare the single-stain control tubes for intracellular markers and unstained cells by adding 100 μL of blood to the tubes labeled as unstained, GzmB, GzmK, and perforin.
Vortex samples immediately after adding FVS575V dye.
Incubate cells with antibodies against surface markers.
Add 2 mL of BD Phosflow™ Lyse/Fix Buffer to tubes containing 100 μL of blood.
Add 4 mL of BD Phosflow™ Lyse/Fix Buffer to tubes containing 200 μL of blood.
Pipette the blood/buffer solution up and down gently 5 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes to permit RBC lysis and leukocyte fixation.
Spin down the tubes at 500 g and room temperature for 7 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatants.
Homogenize cell pellets by flicking the bottom of the tubes or gently vortexing.
Wash cells with 2 mL BD Pharmingen™ Stain Buffer (FBS) by centrifugation at 500 g and RT for 7 min.
Repeat washing step once.
Add a volume of BD Phosflow™ Lyse/Fix Buffer working solution that is 20 times greater than the blood volume to properly lyse RBCs.
Resuspend cell pellets in 100 μL BD Phosflow™ Perm/Wash Buffer I and incubate at 4°C for 20 min for cell permeabilization.
Add antibodies for intracellular staining to respective single-stain control, FMO, and full panel tubes.
Mix with a pipette and incubate at 4°C protected from light for 45 min.
Wash cells with 2 mL BD Phosflow™ Perm/Wash Buffer I by centrifugation at 500 g and 4°C for 7 min.
Repeat washing step once.
Resuspend cell pellets in 300 μL BD Pharmingen™ Stain Buffer (FBS) and acquire the cells on a flow cytometer.
